method: Retrospective causal trace on already known October lectures and saved inputs; not a blind holdout
unchanged_base: active_reference_candidate.py default locked nearest_qualifying max_refs=2 as used in correction_lifecycle_20261012.json
inventory: Continuous strict histogram sign segments; zero starts a separate zero segment and ends prior segment; only completed nonzero same-direction segments enter history. Current segment is excluded from completed history.
record: For every baseline STRUCTURE in scope, retain original event reference. Do not turn window membership changes into CANCEL labels.
window_loss: First prefix at or after confirmation whose last N completed segments in the structure direction omit the original reference start; count even when currently in the opposite sign, since this is history membership only. Record if already absent at confirmation.
opportunity_check: Only on matching-sign prefixes with at least 2 current bars: nearest price prerequisite, reference-window membership, pair price and DIF conditions. Not proof of actual reference selection or decision validity.
raw_cross: First bar strictly after confirmation with direction times current raw DIF minus original reference DIF greater than zero; separate from membership and current active cancellation.
comparators: First raw crossing of original confirmed reference versus first membership loss for windows2 and3; original event/state remains separate. No assumed OR/AND mapping or trade decision updater.
selection_window_check: Separately compare strongest_eligible windows2 versus3 with other parameters fixed; report parity with default nearest2 rather than assume it. Do not conflate this selection comparison with confirmed-reference monitoring.
policy_isolation: Trace strongest_eligible max_refs=2 confirmed records separately as a second profile; no equality with nearest2 is assumed, and their original references are not pooled. Profile added after first diagnostic disclosed a difference, so it is an explicit retrospective extension, not a blind frozen hypothesis.

episode_checkpoint_diagnostic.addition_order: Added after the membership diagnostic and an exploratory cancellation-event probe. All source checkpoint outcomes were already known; this is not a frozen prediction or blind validation.
episode_checkpoint_diagnostic.profiles: Evaluate nearest2 and strongest2 separately at each saved completed-bar endpoint. Carry latest completed bars across periods only for retrospective checkpoint comparison; this is not proof of software intraday timing.
comparators: Both September confirmed references out of last2 completed same-direction history
Both September confirmed references strictly crossed at least once after confirmation
Each period has had a top CANCEL since anchor
Latest top DULL/STRUCTURE/CANCEL event since anchor is CANCEL in each period
episode_checkpoint_diagnostic.event_memory_limits: The last two are competing diagnostic memories, not implemented trading rules. Ignore bottom events only to isolate the top episode; no source yet establishes how bottom events, fresh top activation, trend actions or reference replacement alter episode validity. CANCEL is a local candidate event, not observed invalidation of the original September structure.

source_constraints: Oct16 prior episode still needs 90 and120 disappearance; Oct24 states both disappeared and correction available. Software event anchors conditional; original confirmed reference numbers are not observed.

followup_screen.scope: 2025-10-28 through 2025-11-11, common saved-input coverage of both periods
followup_screen.purpose: Find where sticky-ever top cancellation and latest-top-event cancellation diverge after the known October correction, to identify evidence with discriminating value. Not a new author truth label.
followup_screen.ordering: Declared before evaluating the extension in this diagnostic. Saved numeric inputs and some screenshots had already been seen in earlier research, so do not describe this as untouched holdout data.
followup_screen.output: First divergence and dated state changes; do not infer a new episode starts merely because the candidate emits DULL.

limits: No formal algorithm or trade execution change
History window expiry alone is not presumed episode correction
Historical display removal is not inferred
